issues: Sales came in ahead of target and spend per head improved, while covers fell back after the soft launch offers ended.
Customer retention is now the primary strategic focus in order to stabilise year on year performance.
Bookings shifted towards third party discount platforms for lunch, which pulled revenue down.
Lunch trade is very quiet, so labour is being trimmed across the lunch period.
Labour rose slightly because extra cover was needed for closing and physical tasks that a manager was temporarily unable to carry out.
Front of house still need to improve active upselling, smiling and conversation; one team member is progressing well and is being considered for future management progression.
A one star review alleging food poisoning is being disputed; the timeline was reviewed in the meeting and the site has replied asking the customer for further detail.
A two star review concerned wooden rather than the correct melamine chopsticks being used during a busy shift.
Deliveroo logged inaccurate orders against the site; the team intends to review the order photographs and dispute them.

A corporate event is confirmed for Thursday in the Zen Garden for a party of roughly 25 to 40 guests; a request to extend past 21:30 was refused because of kitchen constraints and the projected spend.
Freshers on Saturday will need sushi distribution support from the site.
Staffing: one team member returns from leave between the middle and the end of October, and a new front of house candidate is being evaluated who will need about two weeks to build confidence.
Google reviews have been consistently five star since Thursday, driven by good service during the lunch offers.
Region-wide (South England): A standing daily performance target of ten app signups and ten Google reviews per site has been set, with a proposal to gamify it so the teams engage with it.

Region-wide (South England): Front of house sometimes ask for a review from a table that has had a poor experience; staff must read the table and check satisfaction before asking, and management should routinely check in on section status.
Region-wide (South England): Sites must report the status of their envelope returns to the office.
The kitchen flooring is a high priority maintenance job and the male toilet sink is medium priority, both logged with operations.
Invoices are not being managed correctly, which is driving a significant wet stock difference.
Even where invoices are completed and double checked, Kobas frequently still shows them as pending for a whole week.
A front of house team member has left.
Bar training is being rolled out to the front of house team, with two team members in training on stock management, ramen and sushi.
The site will distribute sushi at the Freshers Festival London and has booked a discounted Thursday group event.

Resend the reply to the one star food poisoning review if the original reply is not showing - Owner: M18 (15/09/2026)
Call three to five job applicants to follow up on hiring - Owner: M18 (15/09/2026)
Include the daily count of app signups and Google reviews in the end of day report - Owner: M18 (15/09/2026)
Provide the site with a method for tracking app signups - Owner: Kaitlin Docherty (15/09/2026)

Region-wide (South England): Revise the labour target percentages for the coming week - Owner: Kei Cannon (15/09/2026)
Recruit a front of house team member through interviews and trials, with one candidate able to start immediately - Owner: Imre Balogh (15/09/2026)
Fix the invoice entry process so wet stock reconciles and chase the Kobas pending invoice lag - Owner: Imre Balogh (15/09/2026)
